title: Sotogrande Signature
includes: 5 nights at INMOOD San Roque, bed and breakfast, per person sharing a twin or double
4 rounds: La Cañada, The Alto, Hacienda Links and Hacienda Heathland
24-hour concierge from our Sotogrande team
Tee times confirmed before you travel
Flights from Málaga, Seville, Jerez or Gibraltar arranged on request

itinerary.text: Fly into Málaga or Gibraltar, transfer to INMOOD San Roque and settle in.
La Cañada, the local club of Sotogrande, for a gentle opener on fast greens.
The Alto at SO/ Sotogrande, 27 holes in the hills with lunch at the resort.
Hacienda Links on the cliffs at Alcaidesa, Gibraltar in view the whole way round.
Hacienda Heathland, the quieter inland sister course, then a final evening in Sotogrande marina.
Transfer back to the airport and fly home.

aboutHotel: A modern four-star resort in landscaped gardens between San Roque and Sotogrande with over 130 rooms, three places to eat and drink, a big outdoor pool and a gym. La Hacienda and San Roque Club are minutes away and the hotel arranges club and trolley hire on request.
note: Transport is not included. From six golfers a private group transfer usually works out cheaper than hire cars, around €90 to €120 per person for the week based on eight golfers with clubs. A 7-night version with two extra rounds is available on enquiry.

title: Sotogrande Value
includes: 5 nights at Hotel Encinar de Sotogrande, bed and breakfast, per person sharing
4 rounds: La Cañada twice, Hacienda Links and Hacienda Heathland
Golf concierge at the hotel, club and trolley rental available
Tee times confirmed before you travel

itinerary.text: Arrive, transfer to the Encinar inside the Sotogrande estate.
La Cañada, five minutes from the hotel.
Hacienda Heathland above the coast at Alcaidesa.
Hacienda Links, the clifftop course with Gibraltar on the horizon.
Return to La Cañada for the group competition, prize-giving at the hotel bar.
Transfer to the airport.

aboutHotel: A traditional Andalusian four-star inside the Sotogrande estate with garden and golf-view rooms, a Mediterranean restaurant, terrace bar, outdoor pool and tennis courts. Valderrama, La Cañada and The Alto are all within a few minutes.
note: Transport not included; private group transfers from around €90 per person for the week. Price shown is indicative and confirmed on quote.

title: Sotogrande Luxury at SO/
includes: 5 nights at SO/ Sotogrande, bed and breakfast, per person sharing
4 rounds: The Alto twice, Hacienda Links and La Cañada
Buggies at The Alto and spa access throughout
24-hour concierge
Valderrama or Real Sotogrande available as an upgrade round, subject to availability

itinerary.text: Arrive and transfer to SO/ Sotogrande in the hills above the estate.
The Alto, straight from the hotel, Lagos and Pinos loops.
Hacienda Links on the coast, lunch at the clubhouse overlooking Gibraltar.
La Cañada, then an afternoon in the spa.
The Alto again on the Alcornoques loop, or an upgrade round at Valderrama if booked.
Transfer to the airport.

aboutHotel: The five-star resort of Sotogrande with designer interiors, four restaurants and bars, a 3,500 square metre spa, three outdoor pools and The Alto golf course on site with buggies, caddies and concierge.
note: Price shown is indicative and confirmed on quote. Luxury transfers available through the hotel.

title: St Andrews Signature
includes: 5 nights at Drumoig Hotel, bed and breakfast, per person sharing a twin or double
Rounds on the Castle, Eden and Jubilee courses at St Andrews Links
Unlimited Golf: a guaranteed daily tee time including the Torrance and Kittocks courses
60 free practice balls at the St Andrews Links facilities
24-hour concierge
Old Course ballot entry handled for the group

itinerary.text: Fly into Edinburgh, Glasgow, Dundee or Aberdeen and transfer to Drumoig.
The Castle Course, clifftop golf with the town across the bay.
The Eden Course, Harry Colt's forgiving links by the estuary.
The Jubilee Course, the toughest test in St Andrews.
Unlimited golf: the Torrance or Kittocks at the Fairmont, or the Old Course if the ballot comes good.
Fly home from one of four airports.

aboutHotel: A friendly countryside hotel ten minutes from St Andrews with 29 rooms, its own 18-hole course and driving range, and a restaurant and bar for the evenings. Comfortable and well priced, which keeps the package focused on the golf.
note: Transport is not included. Groups of six or more usually save with a private transfer, around €90 to €120 per person for the week based on eight golfers with clubs. Old Course tee times can be guaranteed on request at an additional cost.

title: St Andrews Luxury at the Fairmont
includes: 5 nights at Fairmont St Andrews, bed and breakfast, per person sharing
Rounds on the Torrance and Kittocks courses at the resort
Rounds on the Castle and Jubilee courses at St Andrews Links
Spa access and resort shuttle into St Andrews
24-hour concierge and Old Course ballot entry

itinerary.text: Arrive and transfer to the Fairmont on the cliffs south of town.
The Torrance, the resort's Open qualifying course.
The Castle Course, a short drive along the coast.
The Kittocks, with the afternoon in the spa.
The Jubilee, or the Old Course if the ballot comes good.
Fly home.

aboutHotel: A five-star clifftop resort with 211 rooms, two championship courses on the estate, a full spa, indoor pool and several restaurants, a few minutes from the town and the Links.
note: Price shown is indicative and confirmed on quote. Guaranteed Old Course tee times available on request.

title: St Andrews Town Break
includes: 3 nights at Greyfriars Hotel on North Street, bed and breakfast, per person sharing
3 rounds: the Eden, Jubilee and Castle courses
Walk to the first tee, no cars needed in town
Old Course ballot entry handled for the group

itinerary.text: Arrive, check in on North Street and walk to the Links for the Eden.
The Jubilee in the morning, the pubs of St Andrews in the evening.
Shuttle to the Castle Course, or the Old Course if the ballot comes good.
Fly home from Edinburgh.

aboutHotel: A boutique hotel in the centre of St Andrews with more than 20 rooms and a popular restaurant and bar, a few minutes on foot from the Old Course and the Links Clubhouse.
note: Price shown is indicative and confirmed on quote. A long-weekend format that works well for groups flying in on Friday.

title: Dublin Signature
includes: 5 nights at Druids Glen Hotel & Golf Resort, per person sharing a twin or double
4 rounds: Druids Glen, Druids Heath, Wicklow Golf Club and The K Club Palmer North
Two courses on site, so no travel on three of the golf days
Full access to the resort spa and thermal suite
24-hour concierge

itinerary.text: Fly into Dublin and transfer to Druids Glen in the Wicklow hills.
Druids Glen, the Augusta of Europe, from the hotel door.
Druids Heath, the wilder sister course next door.
Wicklow Golf Club on the cliffs above the Irish Sea.
The K Club, Palmer North, the 2006 Ryder Cup course.
Transfer to Dublin airport and fly home.

aboutHotel: A five-star country estate resort with 145 rooms and suites, Hugo's fine dining, the Garden Rooms, a bar and terrace, and a spa with thermal suite, indoor pool and gym. Both Druids courses are on the estate, with Powerscourt, the Wicklow Mountains and Glendalough nearby.
note: Transport is not included. Groups of six or more usually save with a private driver for the week, around €90 to €120 per person based on eight golfers with clubs.

title: Woodstock House Exclusive
includes: 4 nights with exclusive use of Woodstock House for groups of up to 18
4 rounds: Druids Glen twice, Druids Heath and The K Club Palmer North
Private dining in the house each evening
Full access to the Druids Glen resort spa
24-hour concierge

itinerary.text: Arrive, the house is yours. Welcome dinner in the private dining room.
Druids Glen, straight from the house.
Druids Heath.
The K Club, Palmer North, with the group final back at Druids Glen the next morning.
Final round at Druids Glen, then transfer to the airport.

aboutHotel: A Georgian-style country house inside the Druids Glen estate with nine rooms and suites, two of them panoramic suites over both courses, private dining and full resort access.
note: Price shown is indicative and confirmed on quote. Exclusive use depends on group size.

title: Portmarnock Links & City
includes: 4 nights at Portmarnock Hotel & Golf Links, bed and breakfast, per person sharing
3 rounds: Portmarnock Links twice and The K Club Palmer North
Links on the doorstep, Dublin city 15 minutes away
Spa access and 24-hour concierge

itinerary.text: Land in Dublin, fifteen minutes to the hotel, first round on the links that afternoon.
The K Club, Palmer North.
Free day in Dublin, or a swap round at The Island on request.
Portmarnock Links again for the group final.
Transfer to the airport.

aboutHotel: A four-star coastal resort on the Velvet Strand with 137 rooms, The Bay Restaurant, Cliff Lounge and a spa with indoor pool, and the Bernhard Langer links beside the first tee.
note: Price shown is indicative and confirmed on quote.
